title: Identity, authentication and work privacy
summary: Keep local inspection prototypes distinct from verified accounts, genuine authentication and account-wide privacy enforcement.

goals.title: Local registration inspection
goals.description: Reviewed local Operator and Requester drafts; this component creates no verified account or published profile.

milestones.title: Local Operator and Requester registration inspection
milestones.description: The reusable guided browser flow prepares reviewed local records with optional accessibility/certification information and limited public-field choices. The 9 October milestone creates no server account, verified identity or published profile.
acceptance: Both roles prepare only the deliberately reviewed draft.
Optional private fields stay out of the public candidate unless explicitly eligible and selected.
Edits, reset and late replies cannot restore stale review or private form data.

goals.title: Local face-reference prototype
goals.description: Consented local reference handling and experimental comparison; real-person accuracy and liveness remain unverified.

milestones.title: Local Operator face reference and comparison
milestones.description: The selected local face pipeline implements account-bound encrypted reference retention, explicit replacement/deletion and experimental feature comparison. The 9 October component validation used synthetic inputs; it measured no real-person accuracy or phone performance and establishes no liveness, legal identity or genuine authentication.
acceptance: Operator reference processing and retention require deliberate consent and review.
Requester paths instantiate no face model or biometric reference store.
Transient captures are discarded and experimental comparison preserves unresolved assurance.

goals.title: Authentication and work-state inspection
goals.description: Isolated policy and browser lifecycle behavior with simulated linked devices; account-wide enforcement remains unimplemented.

milestones.title: Isolated authentication and work-state policies
milestones.description: The 8 October developer inspection implements shared Rust policy plus browser cancellation, leases, callback fencing, local work state and simulated linked-device behavior. Genuine authentication and global sensor shutdown remain false.
acceptance: Inspect authentication reuse, hold/clock-out and sensor-access policy independently.
Cancellation and lifecycle loss discard transient authority and fence late results.
Reload never restores active operations or sensor grants.
